summary: DeepSeek-V4.1 decode no longer drifts from the model as generation lengthens: the complete compressor-ring fix from vllm #926
compatibility: No user action required. Supersedes the vllm-933 note: that measurement covered only the first half of #926, which cannot run on its own.
details: Circular-buffer KV groups now get a worker slot mapping, so DeepSeek-V4.1 writes its compressor state ring for every real decode row.

8 prompts x 2,048 greedy tokens on RTX PRO 6000: KL(prefill||decode) at decode steps 1536-2048 fell from 0.156 to 0.018 and top-1 agreement rose from 0.92 to 0.97. Divergence now stays flat with length. Decode speed, DSpark acceptance and KV size are unchanged.
